title: Miniscript behind a timelock or one hash check

schema.around: sane miniscript, or a lone OP_TRUE
schema.also: a lone uncompressed key behind those checks, in P2SH only

note: The check matches a lone OP_TRUE with one CSV or CLTV and DROP, on either side. It also matches one uncompressed key behind that same timelock, and only when that script is the P2SH redeem script. It is not a miniscript parser, and it does not match a hash lock. The same bytes also appear in JoinMarket and Boltz, so this row does not insert an Ark package.
